#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

TRAIN_PID=341425
EVAL_GPU=0
CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/a1_sdf_pi05_spatial_bowl/pi05_lora_baseline_spatial_bowl_seed0"
CHECKPOINT_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/30000"
EVAL_LOG="/root/autodl-tmp/eval_results/eval_spatial_bowl_lora_ctrl_s0.log"

echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): Sentinel started. Monitoring PID $TRAIN_PID"

while kill -0 $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null; do
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): Training PID $TRAIN_PID still running"
    sleep 60
done

echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): Training finished (PID $TRAIN_PID exited)"

# Wait a few seconds for filesystem sync
sleep 5

# Check for 30000 checkpoint; fall back to best
if [ -f "${CHECKPOINT_DIR}/model.safetensors" ]; then
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): Using 30000 checkpoint"
elif [ -f "${CKPT_BASE}/best/model.safetensors" ]; then
    CHECKPOINT_DIR="${CKPT_BASE}/best"
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): 30000 not found, falling back to best checkpoint"
else
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): ERROR - no checkpoint found at $CKPT_BASE"
    exit 1
fi

echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC'): Starting eval on GPU $EVAL_GPU with checkpoint $CHECKPOINT_DIR"

cd /root/colliforce-vla
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$EVAL_GPU python scripts/eval_safelibero.py \
    --checkpoint "$CHECKPOINT_DIR" \
    --config_name pi05_libero \
    --model_type lora_baseline \
    --pi05 \
    --suite safelibero_spatial \
    --safety_level II \
    --n_episodes 50 \
    --seed 7 \
    --gpu 0 \
    > "$EVAL_LOG" 2>&1
